---
title: "Overall survival with unrestricted follow-up — imputation"
subtitle: "Five completed datasets for supporting PH and non-PH models"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This supporting-analysis imputation uses the same baseline variables and MICE
methods as the primary overall-survival analysis. The death indicator and
Nelson--Aalen estimate are instead based on unrestricted follow-up. The same
five completed datasets are used by the PH and non-PH models.

```{r}
#| label: impute-supporting-os-unrestricted
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
input_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)
output_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-unrestricted", "imputations.rds"
)
dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (force || !file.exists(output_path)) {
  prepared <- arrow::read_parquet(input_path) |>
    dplyr::select(
      id, tx, survival_time_days_unrestricted, status_death_unrestricted,
      ecog_fstcnt, stage_binary, lung, age, gender, albumin, bilirubin,
      c_reactive_protein, lactate_dehydrogenase
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      ecog_binary = derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt),
      mgps = derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein),
      ecog_fstcnt = ordered(ecog_fstcnt, levels = 0:4),
      gender = factor(gender)
    )

  prepared$na_est <- mice::nelsonaalen(
    prepared,
    timevar = survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    statusvar = status_death_unrestricted
  )
  prepared <- prepared |>
    dplyr::relocate(ecog_binary, mgps, .after = dplyr::last_col())

  methods <- mice::make.method(prepared)
  predictors <- mice::make.predictorMatrix(prepared)

  fixed_columns <- c(
    "id", "tx", "survival_time_days_unrestricted",
    "status_death_unrestricted", "na_est"
  )
  methods[fixed_columns] <- ""
  methods["ecog_fstcnt"] <- "polr"
  methods["ecog_binary"] <- "~I(derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt))"
  methods["mgps"] <- "~I(derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein))"
  predictors[fixed_columns, ] <- 0
  predictors[, c(
    "id", "survival_time_days_unrestricted", "ecog_binary", "mgps"
  )] <- 0

  imputation <- mice::mice(
    prepared,
    method = methods,
    predictorMatrix = predictors,
    m = config$imputation$supporting$m,
    maxit = config$imputation$supporting$maxit,
    donors = config$imputation$supporting$donors,
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", offset = 600L),
    printFlag = FALSE
  )
  saveRDS(imputation, output_path, compress = "xz")
}

imputation <- readRDS(output_path)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-supporting-os-unrestricted-imputation-traces
#| fig-cap: "MICE trace plots for directly imputed variables in the unrestricted-follow-up OS analyses"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| echo: false

plot(imputation, layout = c(2, 5))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-supporting-os-unrestricted-imputation-distributions

#| fig-width: 10

    ecog_fstcnt + mgps,

)
```
